name: M. F. Husain
summary:
Maqbool Fida Husain was an Indian painter and film director who painted narrative paintings in a modified Cubist style. One of the founding members of Bombay Progressive Artists' Group, Husain is associated with Indian modernism in the 1940s. His early association with the Bombay Progressive Artists' Group used modern technique, and was inspired by the "new" India after the partition of 1947.

His narrative paintings, executed in a modified Cubist style, can be caustic and funny as well as serious and sombre. M. F.
